ābhicetasika.p: [Ābhiceta+ṇika] (ti) CL=7 (A) Depending on the noble and pure mind, (believes in the three Gems and fulfilled/perfection with morals , Magga and Phala). (B) Based on(depend on) extraordinary and pure Upacāra Jhāna consciousness (due to be free from the opposite status and good than natural Kāmāvacara mind) (Kāmāvacara means can be caught in a vicious circle of eleven levels of existence given to the pursuit of sensual pleasure), four kinds of Jhāna. (C) It is depend/based on noble Mahagguta consciousness (due to free from the opposite status such as Kāmacchanda), four kinds of Jhāna. (Kāmacchanda means desire the sensual pleasure).
